parts.name: ToggleGroup
parts.description: A `<div>` with the `group` role that holds which of its toggles are pressed. It is one Tab stop: the arrow keys, Home and End move between its toggles. Inside a toolbar the toolbar owns the keyboard instead.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the pressed toggles. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values pressed at first, when the group isn't controlled. None by default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new array of pressed values when a toggle is pressed or released, in a change of its own: it may be an action that saves without holding the group.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether several toggles can be pressed at once. Without it, pressing one releases the other.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every toggle in the group. The group is also disabled inside a disabled toolbar or toolbar group.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move between the toggles: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight when `horizontal`, ArrowUp and ArrowDown when `vertical`.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-multiple
dataAttributes.description: Present when several toggles can be pressed at once.
